subject: FLAG-02 directive
notes:
PB55 FOLD (2026-10-15, owner decision 2026-08-08 'THE RULE IS THE UNIT'): the transcription printed this rule's nested list(s) at column 0, so 4 sub-item(s) held rows of their own; indented at their measured printed level, they are this rule's body and their adjudications are folded here, nothing dropped.

[the rule's own record before the fold]
kb/Work PB1376 (w1012k). cite.py --check 7.3.14.4 'ALL: All of the options apply' OK (GR4 a, sub-item path mispathed by cite.py, kb/Work PB718). a) ALL fans out to every FLAG-02 option at fold time. b) head: the TURN-name set is exactly EC-ALL, EC-PROGRAM, EC-PROGRAM-ARG-OMITTED, EC-PROGRAM-NOT-FOUND (EcProgramFamily); any TURN naming one, ON or OFF, is a candidate, and EACH is flagged at its own line: two qualifying directives in one source element are two located warnings (EcProgram_EachQualifyingTurnIsFlaggedAtItsOwnLine). A TURN written before an element's IDENTIFICATION DIVISION belongs to the element that follows it (SourceElementOf; 7.3.25.4 GR6). The b CONDITION (calls a function / invokes a method) is adjudicated on GR-7.3.14.4-L2.1 / -L2.2. kb/Work PB1952 (w1042a): GR4 d) and e) are asked of every source element; a METHOD body now resolves its operands in the method's own name scope (11.7.4 GR5) over its class half's forest (VisitMethodDefinition activates the OoMethodDataScope the statement binder uses), and an index-name is found through the scope-aware SymbolTable.IndexCandidates, so a method-local or object AE / IX is flagged as in a program.

[folded GR-7.3.14.4-L2.1 = §7.3.14.4 4) b) 1.: CONFORMS]
kb/Work PB1375 (w1012k). cite.py --check 7.3.14.4 'the source element calls any function, or' OK (GR4 b 1); 12.3.8.4 GR13 'intrinsic-function-name-1 may be specified as a function-identifier without being preceded by the keyword FUNCTION'. A source element is a source unit excluding its contained source units (3.164): the pass opens one per program, function, contained program, class, interface and method. A call is a FunctionCall node, a keyword-omitted function-identifier (the binder records its decision in DataBinder.ActivationSites at IntrinsicBinder.KeywordOmittedFunction, so the pass reads the bound fact instead of re-deriving it from syntax), or a function written inside a subscript (ReferenceResolver.IsFunctionBearing records its head token). A call inside a method now flags that method's TURN.

[folded GR-7.3.14.4-L2.2 = §7.3.14.4 4) b) 2.: CONFORMS]
kb/Work PB1375 (w1012k). Row carries three halves. (1) GR4 b 2: cite.py --check 7.3.14.4 'the source element invokes any method' OK. INVOKE, an inline method invocation and an object-property reference (8.4.3.9.4 GR1: the occurrence invokes the get/set accessor; recorded by ReferenceResolver.OoTryBindPropertyReference in DataBinder.ActivationSites) mark the CURRENT source element, and a METHOD definition is a source element of its own (VisitMethodDefinition), so a TURN in a method that invokes is flagged and a TURN in a sibling method that invokes nothing is not. A contained program is its own element too: its calls do not count for its container. (2) GR4 c I-O-STATUS-07: CLOSE with WITH NO REWIND or UNIT (REEL equivalent per 14.9.6.3 SR2) flagged once. (3) GR4 d head: same-DDE test by symbol identity across plain and CORRESPONDING MOVE, resolved in the CONTAINED program's own scope (the unit map is keyed on the IDENTIFICATION DIVISION node a contained program shares with its synthetic programUnit).

[folded GR-7.3.14.4-L3.1 = §7.3.14.4 4) d) 1.: CONFORMS]
kb/Work PB1375 (w1012k). cite.py --check 7.3.14.4 'the operands are of category alphanumeric-edited, or' OK (GR4 d 1); 8.4.3.3.4 GR6 a 'the category alphanumeric-edited is considered class and category alphanumeric'. An alphanumeric-edited self-move is flagged; a plain alphanumeric one is not; a reference-modified operand is category alphanumeric (IsRefModified, covering a refModPart, a captured depth-0-colon group and the qualified form), so it does not meet criterion 1. National-edited is deliberately excluded (the flag is narrower than 14.9.25.4 GR6 b by the printed text).

[folded GR-7.3.14.4-L3.2 = §7.3.14.4 4) d) 2.: CONFORMS]
kb/Work PB1375 (w1012k).
